Dr. Roy Guerrero is a native of Uvalde, attended Robb Elementary as a child, and is the only pediatrician in the area. Five of his patients died that day.
 
In his own words, he saw “bodies [that] had been pulverized by bullets”
 
It's time we ban these weapons of war.

This is a BIG deal!
 
The agreement between Sens. Manchin and Schumer will allow Medicare to negotiate lower drug prices, reduce inflation, create thousands of new jobs, make historic investments in clean energy, and will not raise taxes on families making under $400,000 a year.

The #InflationReductionAct will cap out of pocket Medicare costs to $2,000 per year and will allow Medicare to negotiate drug prices. 

This is real help for people and will reduce the rise in prices. Let’s get it passed.
